en.title: Asian Games men's basketball roundup: Chinese Taipei advances to quarterfinals, South Korea secures three-game winning streak
en.summary: Chinese Taipei defeated Qatar to advance to the quarterfinals with a 2-1 group record. South Korea beat Japan to finish atop Group A with three consecutive victories and qualify for the quarterfinals.

en.title: 2026 men's and women's hockey youth Asian Cup: India sweeps both titles
en.summary: India won both the men's and women's championships at the 2026 Hockey Youth Asian Cup after 60 matches. China's men's and women's teams secured places in the 2027 Hockey Youth World Cup.

en.summary: New Oriental founder and Oriental Zhaixuan CEO Yu Minhong led a team on a cultural and tourism livestream tour through Heilongjiang Province along the China-Russia border.

en.title: Over 100 Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Students Gather in Beijing to Expand Their 'Circle of Friends'
en.summary: A closing ceremony for the 13th Beijing-Hong Kong student welcoming exchange camp, themed around the 29th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to China, took place in Beijing with over 100 students from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan participating.

stories.title: WTT澳门冠军赛：莫雷加德、张本美和分获男、女单打冠军

en.title: WTT Macao Champions: Moregard and Zhang Ben Meho Win Men's and Women's Singles Titles
en.summary: Swedish player Truls Moregard and Japanese player Zhang Ben Meho won the men's and women's singles championships respectively at the World Table Tennis Professional League Macao Champions finals held in Macao on September 13.

stories.title: 一列车在波乌边境乌方一侧遭无人机撞击

en.title: Train Struck by Drone on Ukrainian Side of Poland-Ukraine Border
en.summary: A train heading to Warsaw was hit by a drone on the Ukrainian side of the Poland-Ukraine border on September 13. The train received advance warning and no casualties resulted from the incident.

en.title: "Two Parks and One River" Beijing West Rafting Festival Coordinated Across Three Districts
en.summary: The "Two Parks and One River" Beijing West Rafting Festival expanded on September 13 from a single water area in Shijingshan District to activities across Shijingshan, Fengtai and Mentougou districts, broadening offerings from professional competitions to public water recreation experiences.

en.summary: A century-old mining operation in Loudi has undergone transformation and development, becoming an example recognized by international organizations.

en.title: Service Trade Fair features multiple "firsts", helping Chinese enterprises expand overseas beyond initial stages
en.summary: The service trade conference showcases new opportunities for Chinese companies seeking to deepen their international business operations, with examples of firms stabilizing operations abroad.

en.title: Xi Jinping concludes attendance at 18th BRICS Leaders Summit and returns to Beijing
en.summary: China's President Xi Jinping completed his participation in the 18th BRICS Leaders Summit and returned to Beijing on the evening of September 13.

en.title: For China, H-6N bomber enhances nuclear deterrence and second-strike capability
en.summary: The People's Liberation Army demonstrated its H-6N bomber carrying a nuclear-capable air-launched ballistic missile, highlighting China's airborne nuclear strike capability during a military exercise.

stories.title: Why Chinese shoppers are ditching supermarkets for small ‘community stores’

en.title: Why Chinese shoppers are ditching supermarkets for small 'community stores'
en.summary: Chinese consumers are shifting to small community stores that offer lower prices than traditional supermarkets while providing wider selection than convenience chains. These new retailers are attracting shoppers seeking affordable grocery options with convenient neighborhood locations.

stories.title: Rise and fall of Hong Kong’s ‘shop kings’: how plunging rents, debt crushed their empires

en.title: Rise and fall of Hong Kong's 'shop kings': how plunging rents, debt crushed their empires
en.summary: Hong Kong property landlords who once dominated retail districts have faced bankruptcy as commercial rents collapsed and bank lending tightened following the pandemic. Shop prices have declined over 40 percent from their 2018 peak with limited signs of recovery.

stories.title: Next-gen wealthy Hongkongers drop property for higher returns in deposits and hedge funds

en.title: Next-gen wealthy Hongkongers drop property for higher returns in deposits and hedge funds
en.summary: Affluent Hong Kong residents are shifting away from property investment toward bank deposits and hedge funds seeking better financial returns. The trend reflects changing investment preferences among the city's wealthy families.

stories.title: How AI tools are reshaping stock trading, investment research in China

en.title: How AI tools are reshaping stock trading, investment research in China
en.summary: Quantitative traders in China are increasingly using artificial intelligence tools to automate research and data analysis tasks. AI agents now help investors collect historical data and analyze market patterns to inform trading decisions more quickly than traditional manual methods.
